description: Upload a complete custom theme (Pro plan; free on every plan until 2027-01-01) as a new commit in its Git repo. Files are validated and compiled at once — a 422 lists every problem as `path: message` lines — then compiled in the background: poll theme_get until status is ready, then theme_publish. Without theme_id, role development reuses your one development theme and role unpublished creates a new theme; with theme_id it stores the next version of that theme. Updating the live theme needs allow_live: true.

allow_live.description: With the live theme's id: update the live site in place

role.description: development = your private work-in-progress theme (one per user, replaced on each upload); unpublished = a saved theme ready to publish

theme_id.description: A theme id from theme_list (or the system theme id lokand-base)

name: theme_upload
title: Theme upload
